findings.message: `plan = read_plan(ctx.repo)` yields `None` when `CHUPA_PLAN.md` is absent, and `_review_seeds` passes it unchanged to `_review_one` (declared `plan: str`). `_review_one` then calls `required_units(plan, seed_stem, citations)`, which reaches `registry_rows` and `_REGISTRY.findall(None)` and raises `TypeError`. `resolve_plan_contract(plan, ...)` on the same path would also fail, on `plan.splitlines`. So any ticket with `tickets` in its scope fence that adds a seed candidate on a no-plan host still crashes at seed review. The diff only replaces the `FileNotFoundError` with a `TypeError`. The ticket names `stages.py` seed review as in scope and its Definition of rejected covers any path that can still raise because the plan is absent. No test covers this path.
findings.paved_road: Make the seed-review path tolerate an absent plan the way `implement_stage` and `hold_on_hardening` do: use `plan = read_plan(ctx.repo) or ""` at this line, so `required_units` returns no units and citations fall through to `validate_ticket`, which reports a `## Plan contract` citation against an absent plan as a ticket finding. Add a no-plan seed-review test to `tests/test_no_plan_host.py` that fails on the current code.
